tools.name: generate_textures
tools.description: Start a background texture job and return its job_id at once. A job that starts while another runs waits in a queue and runs after it. Pass prompt (with backend, seeds, resolution, name, maps, ao) for one texture, or requests for a batch: a list of request objects with the same fields, run as one job that loads each model once. Pass one or the other, not both. backend is z-image-turbo, flux2-klein-4b, or both. Poll get_texture_job(job_id) for progress and the PNG paths. If the mflux or mlx module is missing, the job is refused with texture.dependencies_missing; run texture generation from the plugin root.

requests.description: A batch: one request object per texture, with the fields above (prompt, backend, seeds, resolution, name, maps, ao, style_suffix). Use instead of prompt.

tools.name: get_texture_job
tools.description: Return a texture job's state: queued, running (completed/total), succeeded (with PNG paths and timings), or failed (with code, message, and remediation).

tools.name: texture_backends
tools.description: Report each texture backend as available, not_installed, unsupported_platform, insufficient_memory, or dependencies_missing (the mflux or mlx module is not installed; run from the plugin root).

tools.name: texture_contact_sheet
tools.description: Rebuild the contact sheet (contact_sheet_NNN.png) at the output root from every texture set, with each albedo tiled 2x2 under its set name, backend, and seed. Returns pages, cells, and skipped albedos, or texture.no_texture_sets when the root holds no sets. Needs no texture model.
